source.read_mode: actual 1647 first-print page images independently viewed; page 115 table in two columns essential / debilities and accidental fortitudes/debilities; page 116 expressly postpones full application to examples
source.source_normalization: This register separates directly legible source scores from historical application and missing-input issues; signs of scores are normalized for computation, not printed minus glyphs.

evidence_backbone.chapter_XVII_101_104_five_positive_digni: This remains source-defined as a SUBSET, originally in the previous research artifact.
evidence_backbone.printed_p115_adds_mutual_reception: Domicile dignity +5 may arise from mutual reception by house; exaltation dignity +4 may also arise by reception. Not included in previous table-only S5 calculator.
evidence_backbone.printed_p115_essential_debilities: Detriment -5, fall -4, peregrine -5. Previous S5 calculator did NOT include any negative debility penalties.
evidence_backbone.printed_p115_accidental_fortitudes: Numerical positions, relative motion, sect/orientality, combustion, good/malefic partile contacts, historically specified star conjunctions.
evidence_backbone.printed_p115_accidental_debilities: House penalties, retrogradation, slow motion, solar combustion and beams, malefic contact and historical stellar configuration.
evidence_backbone.printed_p116_no_universal_practical_exam: Lilly says he will explain the table later by example; printed table alone does not license deterministic resolving of all ties, receptions and contrary testimonies.
evidence_backbone.printed_cv_531_532: Lilly's favorite Lord of Geniture combines essential AND accidental fortitudes and allows near-equal planets to participate. Earlier Greek custom at Moon/Mercury places is a separate reported method.
evidence_backbone.printed_cvii_535_536: Earlier manners rules remain necessary; final essential-place comparison cannot overwrite them.
